correctness.rationale: Axioms P3 and P4 force every row to depend only on the meet. P1/P2 force the top identity row and atomic diagonal values. P5 is exactly two restrictions on each atom row, yielding 2, 2x3 and four-colored directed-map families for the three bottom values. Cycle-wise equivariance has 4+Fix(sigma^d)-1 choices, which proves Burnside. Rooted-tree/cycle decomposition proves the OGF; the standard Otter square-root singularity and coefficient transfer prove the K rho^{-m}m^{-1/2} law. Two exact scripts corroborate sizes 2 through 10, with direct full-axiom evaluation for 2 through 4. No inference from finite experiments to infinity.

value.rationale: Counting isomorphism types rather than labeled tables is a natural, complete algebraic-semantic classification for the canonical nondistributive height-two family. The four-colored functional-graph decomposition exposes structure and yields all-size exact numbers, a closed OGF, and a sharp analytic growth exponent with explicit coefficient. It is not an arbitrary sample or a tiny numerical improvement. The theorem does not overclaim conclusions for other lattice classes.
